name: keboola
description: Explore, query and build in your Keboola projects: inspect tables, run SELECT queries, create SQL transformations and flows, and debug failed jobs through the Keboola MCP server.

interface.longDescription:
Connect ChatGPT to your Keboola projects. Explore buckets and tables, ask questions about your data with read-only SQL, build Snowflake or BigQuery SQL transformations, run them in flows, and find out why a job failed.

You sign in with your Keboola account. First you choose your Keboola region, then you log in to Keboola and approve access. ChatGPT can reach only the projects your Keboola account can reach, with the same role and permissions you have in Keboola. Before the plugin creates or changes anything, it asks you to confirm the project, and it asks again before it runs a job.

The plugin cannot delete projects, buy or change subscriptions, or run write statements through SQL queries. Data changes go through Keboola transformations, which you can review in Keboola.
defaultPrompt: Show me the tables in my Keboola project and what they contain.
Create a SQL transformation that aggregates daily orders.
Why did my last Keboola job fail?
